description: Returns authorization or safe connection metadata without provider credentials.

fields.name: authorizationUrl
fields.description: OAuth URL to open in a browser.

fields.name: state
fields.description: Opaque OAuth state used only by the backend callback.

fields.name: expiresAt
fields.description: Authorization state expiry timestamp in milliseconds.

fields.name: connections
fields.description: Safe owned Amazon Ads connection metadata.

fields.name: profiles
fields.description: Safe Amazon Ads profiles for the selected connection.

fields.name: profiles[].profileId
fields.description: Amazon Ads profile ID.

fields.name: profiles[].countryCode
fields.description: Profile country code.

fields.name: profiles[].currencyCode
fields.description: Profile currency code.

fields.name: errcode
fields.description: Upstream status code returned by the provider.

fields.name: errmsg
fields.description: Upstream status message returned by the provider.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Provider-specific status code.

fields.name: msg
fields.description: Provider-specific status message.

fields.name: message
fields.description: Provider-specific message.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Provider-specific render or payload type.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Provider-specific response title.

fields.name: sourceType
fields.description: Provider-specific source platform type.

fields.name: sourceTool
fields.description: Provider-specific source tool name.

fields.name: costToken
fields.description: Token cost reported by the upstream provider.

fields.name: costTime
fields.description: Execution time reported by the upstream provider.

fields.name: page
fields.description: Current page returned by the upstream provider.

fields.name: pageSize
fields.description: Page size returned by the upstream provider.

fields.name: pageItemCount
fields.description: Item count on the current page returned by the upstream provider.

fields.name: totalPage
fields.description: Total page count returned by the upstream provider.
